purpose: Check whether matrix-style dense layouts understate building harm and whether irregular footprints/courtyard placement alter one-source coverage.

layout.open: No buildings; matched node/source positions and seeds.
layout.mixed: Irregular 8-20 metre footprints, target cover 0.25, courtyard gaps; nodes in central courtyard and source behind an outer building.
layout.dense_urban: Irregular 15-45 metre footprints, target cover 0.55, courtyard clusters; nodes in or behind courtyards and source in a courtyard or behind an opposite footprint. Layout constants are synthetic placeholders.

comparison: Site-paired dense_urban and mixed coverage against open under realism off/on; report intervals, counts, and old matrix dense-urban one-source cells without changing old sites.

sealed_set.action: Do not modify, run, or regenerate.
